instructions.bw: Make the image black and white.
instructions.watercolor: Render the image as a watercolor painting.

notes: Instructions are global appearance changes. They avoid the InstructPix2Pix failure modes of counting, spatial rearrangement, viewpoint changes, moving objects, and isolating small objects. Wording is frozen. Keys are the existing 8-bit and 16-bit short-payload keys. New messages and Gaussian draws are independent of that study. A trial shares one magnitude tensor across both lengths and all six image/instruction cases. Codeword signs differ by length.
